correctness.rationale: Exact iid stream and independent exponential first-occurrence races prove limit Bernoulli factors; highest-category coupling gives TV error at most (1-p_d)^n. Explicit exact sample enumeration and rational discriminants exclude finite prefix Poisson–binomial representation for two parameter vectors. Coefficient convergence to the limit PGF with distinct simple negative zeros implies eventual exact real-rootedness and hence Poisson–binomial factorization. Checker tests 48 rational DP/TV cases and enumerates 125 and 256 words; tests are supplementary, not infinite proofs.

value.rationale: It identifies an otherwise hidden time-dependent structural transition for a canonical finite-support record statistic: iid discrete record counts at the first nontrivial horizon can violate independent-Bernoulli sum representability although their limiting distribution possesses independent components and generic finite-time horizons eventually restore exact representability. Explicit algebraic obstructions, robust open neighborhoods, and TV control make it a motivated boundary phenomenon rather than a parameter substitution or single unmotivated numerical calculation.
